versions.changelog: Routes find-places: the places inside one neighborhood by name, street or kind; get-resources is counts only.
Ratings for every school, high schools included; commute as a range

rank-neighborhoods now counts parks (the share of homes within a 10-minute walk of an NYC Parks playground) and diversity, ranks like Best fit on motley.nyc, and names any priority word it doesn't measure (MCP 0.5.0).

Three new tools: explain-score (how each score is computed and how it moves with neighborhood income), find-collections (school and neighborhood lists picked by a stated rule) and get-admissions-timeline (every NYC application ahead for a child's grade). Non-residential areas are no longer scored, and answers say so.

Covers all 17 tools on the hosted server: adds find-school (a school by name or DBN) and get-zoned-school (the zoned elementary school for a home address). Adds two rules: never estimate a family's admission odds, and link the Motley page a tool returns. Replaces the paid-plan line with a plain out-of-scope note.
